title: 第16章 大佬，你就是我亲爹啊！-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    这番话干脆利落，许默顾虑确实减少了一些。

    既然命悬一线，过度藏私只会催生裂痕。

    许默深吸一口气，掌心翻转。

    一瓶他制作酿造的特效酒出现了。

    “既然事上见，我也交个底。”

    “我的初始天赋，是【酿酒师】。可以酿造出带有特殊附加属性的酒水。”

    方芸的眼睛注视着这些酒。

    “目前能弄出三种。”

    “基础花酿，你也用过的，恢复理智和饱腹感；蛇胆酒，附带‘冷血’状态，短时间内无视一切负面情绪流失；还有这个……”

    “最后一种，就是蜂蜜花酿，用你给我的蜂蜜酿造而成，可以获得触角能力，能够与蜜蜂和蚂蚁沟通。”

    方芸死死盯着地上的酒瓶，眼中光彩不断。

    几秒钟后，她猛地仰起头，眼底爆发出难以掩饰的狂热。

    何止是赌对了！

    “我就说吧！大佬，你就是我亲爹啊！”

    许默被她的玩笑逗乐了。

    情绪平复后，两人的目光再次投向那疯狂滚动的交易面板，试图从情报中抽丝剥茧。

    很快，一条隐藏的残酷规则逐渐浮出水面。

    方芸指着几条跨频道的求购信息分析。

    “看出问题了吗？”

    “不同分频道的出生点，资源分配是极端割裂的。”

    许默目光如炬。

    他出生点所在的分频道，满地枯草残垣，资源极度贫瘠，怪物更是密集得令人发指，玩家死伤率高的吓人。

    但这里不缺资源，如果能活下去，或许可以称霸一方。

    而方芸之前所在的频道，从兔肉和浆果来看，显然有着丰富的活物可以捕食。

    并且，方芸还有过罐头和蜂蜜。

    但对应的，这地方极度匮乏金属和坚硬石材，甚至连一把最基础的石镐都凑不出来。

    不同的频道，不仅物资错位，连白天黑夜的交替规律、怪物的刷新机制都存在着致命的差异。

    系统在刻意制造不平衡，逼迫幸存者去交易，去疯狂厮杀。

    许默后背渗出一层冷汗。

    随后抬起头，目光柔和了几分。

    “这么说起来，我现在是真得好好谢谢你。”

    如果不是方芸不顾一切地激活传送功能，将两人绑定在这座石屋里，以他所在频道的恐怖环境，就算没被迷雾怪活活撕成碎片，也只有一个结局。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

These words were concise and clear, and Xu Mo's worries were indeed reduced.

Since life hangs on a thread, excessive hiding of personal secrets will only lead to cracks.

Xu Mo took a deep breath and turned his palms over.

A bottle of special-effect wine he brewed appeared.

"Since we have seen the matter, I will explain it to you."

"My initial talent is [Winemaker]. I can brew wine with special additional properties."

Fang Yun’s eyes stared at the wine.

"There are currently three types available."

"Basic flower brew, which you have also used, restores sanity and satiety; snake bile wine, which comes with a 'cold-blooded' state, ignores the loss of all negative emotions in a short period of time; and this..."

“The last one is honey flower brew, which is brewed with the honey you gave me. It can gain the ability of tentacles and communicate with bees and ants.”

Fang Yun stared at the wine bottle on the ground, her eyes constantly shining.

A few seconds later, she raised her head suddenly, her eyes bursting with unconcealable fanaticism.

It’s more than just a right bet!

"Let me tell you! Boss, you are my biological father!"

Xu Mo was amused by her joke.

After their emotions calmed down, the two of them turned their attention to the crazily scrolling transaction panel again, trying to extract clues from the information.

Soon, a hidden cruel rule gradually surfaced.

Fang Yun pointed to several pieces of cross-channel purchase information analysis.

"Do you see the problem?"

“The resource allocation for different sub-channel spawn points is extremely fragmented.”

Xu Mo’s eyes were as bright as a torch.

The sub-channel where his birth point is located is full of withered grass and ruins, the resources are extremely poor, the monsters are extremely dense, and the player casualty rate is frighteningly high.

But there is no shortage of resources here. If you can survive, you may be able to dominate one side.

Judging from the rabbit meat and berries, the channel that Fang Yun was on before clearly had abundant living animals for prey.

Furthermore, Fang Yun also had canned food and honey.

But correspondingly, this place is extremely short of metal and hard stone, and even a basic stone pickaxe cannot be found.

Different channels not only have misplaced supplies, but also have fatal differences in the alternation of day and night and the refresh mechanism of monsters.

The system is deliberately creating an imbalance, forcing survivors to trade and fight crazily.

A layer of cold sweat broke out on Xu Mo's back.

Then he raised his head, his eyes softening a bit.

"In that case, I really need to thank you very much now."

“If Fang Yun hadn’t desperately activated the teleportation function and bound the two of them in this stone house, given the terrifying environment of his channel, there would have been only one ending even if he hadn’t been torn to pieces by the fog monster.
